scope: Read-only hypothesis for later throughput research on the same four L4s; not a gate for C24 or real submission. No GPU run, source/policy change or query gold.

facts.hardware: 4 NVIDIA L4, nvidia-smi total23034MiB each; engine reports22.03GiB device memory

log_values.note: Profiled/cache/GPU allocated memory counters use different accounting and rounding; do not treat their sum as an exact nvidia-smi decomposition.

GPU_samples.note: These are saved C24 run observations, not current live GPU inspection or a throughput measurement.

facts.communication: Actual TP4 log disables custom allreduce on >2 PCIe-only GPUs and selects PYNCCL.

estimates.assumptions: Same FP8 checkpoint, BF16/auto attention KV, MTP2/align, no offload or new cache precision. Approximate TP-sharded weights and cache bytes double per GPU when TP4 becomes TP2; replicated tensors, page grouping and profiling can deviate.

full_attention_only_lower_bound.formula: 16 full layers * (K+V=2) * (4 KV heads / TP2=2) * head_dim256 * BF16_2bytes
full_attention_only_lower_bound.excluded: All48 GDN state/checkpoints, MTP cache, CUDA graphs, activations and non-torch buffers are excluded; real demand is larger.

estimates.judgement: Loading one TP2 replica with max_model_len65536 is plausible from the memory envelope. Two replicas, each promising four simultaneously long49K/40K generations up to65536 total context, are not a credible cache-fit assumption at the current precision. max_num_seqs4 limits scheduling, not four fully resident65536 contexts.
estimates.likely_failure_mode: An engine may start and run four short requests, then encounter KV pressure/preemption/recomputation or lower effective concurrency as outputs grow. This can erase the communication benefit.

hybrid_Mamba_and_MTP_limits: TP2 has no obvious head-count divisibility blocker: attention24/KV4/GDNkey16/GDNvalue48 are all divisible by2. Actual kernels/loading with this exact FP8 wheel atTP2 remain unrun.
GDN recurrent/conv states depend on TP size and speculative-token count. Prefix-cache checkpoints and unified page padding add memory beyond the pure full-attention formula.
The actual TP4 engine chooses attention block800 and adds3 padding layers; simple dense-attention KV arithmetic alone understates the observed memory layout.
Pinned Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.5MTP reject mamba-cache-mode all; retain align with prefix caching. Changing TP does not remove this restriction.
Cache blocks and prefix-cache state are local to each replica; the two TP2 engines cannot pool their spare KV memory.
Reducing max_num_seqs8 to4 can reduce graph/buffer costs, but a few hundred MiB of savings do not supply the several GiB needed for four long contexts.

concrete_later_hypothesis.potential_benefit: Two-rank PCIe collectives may be cheaper than four-rank PYNCCL, and a two-GPU group may qualify for custom allreduce if P2P checks pass; this is not yet established on the Kaggle allocation.
concrete_later_hypothesis.memory_condition: Any meaningful twoTP2 comparison must observe actual cache capacity and long-request residency. The evidence points toward about1-2 full contexts per replica, or four much shorter contexts, rather than four full-length contexts.
concrete_later_hypothesis.non_gate: No new run is requested or started here; proceed with frozen C24 then the real submission before any later throughput study.

unconfirmed: Actual TP2 weight memory, activation peak, CUDA graph size, allocator block count and engine startup with MTP2.
Whether TP2 P2P/custom allreduce is enabled, and its benefit at useful ARC prefill/decode lengths.
Actual two-replica accepted-output-token throughput, MTP acceptance, preemption count, tail latency and output quality.
Linear extrapolation of the TP4 hybrid cache-token figure to TP2; estimates are not a measured capacity guarantee.

primary_sources.supports: TP size and speculative count feed GDN state shape; all prefix mode rejected.
GDN heads/states are partitioned by TP; do not transfer Marlin-specific constraints to observed TritonFP8 kernel.
Pinned align/all/none semantics and separate Mamba cache dtype settings.
Unified page sizes and Mamba state padding can waste memory.
Cache-token/concurrency log interpretation; generic documentation, not the exact pinned version.
TP and replicas can combine; max_num_seqs applies per replica/rank; latest docs are not proof of pinned runtime behavior.
